X.title: Nemeris
X.text:
Nemeris is an independent island country. Its government moved the capital from Karda to Oltan in 1998.

The constitution recognizes Nemeri as the official language.

Nemeris uses the island crown as its national currency.

X.title: Isolde Varn
X.text:
Isolde Varn worked as a conservator.

She was born on 4 May 1961 in Pellaro and spent her childhood in Tivren.

The Merwick Museum invited her to restore its textile collection.

X.title: Duskfen Island
X.text:
Duskfen Island is an island administered by the neighboring country of Ferond.

The northern shore is bounded by the Marn Strait.

X.title: Tal Orvane
X.text:
Tal Orvane was a ceramicist who specialized in glazed vessels.

Orvane opened a workshop in Ulder in 2001.

X.title: Asterin
X.text:
Asterin is a sovereign state on a river delta.

Most settlements lie on the higher banks of the River Savael.

Cross-border trade is important, and the national currency is the ast.

X.title: Candlewick Press
X.text:
Candlewick Press is a fictional publishing house.

It began operating in Nelst in 1959.
